Senses.Explanation: The completion of the jade-maiden image: after she casts the shuttle at night, brocade is woven in the western house, capping unimpeded responsive activity. Hongzhi Zhengjue uses the expression through Hongzhi's direct capping comment on the before-midmonth, after-midmonth, and exact-midmonth case. Lingrui Zukui Fu independently deploys it through independent verse deployment that continues with the completed image.
